title: Calendar - Invalid input: expected record, received array

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue report provides a clear description of a bug with tool mcp_google_workspace_calendar_listEvents, complete reproduction details, error message ('Invalid input: expected record, received array'), and client/environment details.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The issue is caused by a localized logic error in McpComplianceTransport where JSON arrays are assigned to structuredContent. Fixing it requires a simple condition check in a single file and a corresponding unit test.

summary.problem: The mcp_google_workspace_calendar_listEvents tool fails with 'Invalid input: expected record, received array' when listing calendar events.
summary.root_cause: McpComplianceTransport parses text content in tool results as JSON and automatically populates structuredContent. When the parsed JSON is an array (e.g. a list of calendar events), setting structuredContent to an array violates the MCP specification and Zod schema expectation that structuredContent must be an object/record.
summary.context: McpComplianceTransport intercepts JSON-RPC responses from MCP servers and populates missing structuredContent from content[0].text if it contains valid JSON. However, structuredContent is required to be an object (Record<string, unknown>).

steps: In packages/core/src/tools/mcp-compliance-transport.ts, update fixStructuredContent to verify that parsed JSON is a non-null, non-array object (typeof parsed === 'object' && parsed !== null && !Array.isArray(parsed)) before assigning it to result.structuredContent.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When an MCP tool response contains a JSON array in content[0].text, McpComplianceTransport should leave structuredContent undefined rather than setting it to an array, preventing schema validation errors.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/core/src/tools/mcp-compliance-transport.test.ts verifying that tool results containing a JSON array in content[0].text do not set structuredContent.
Run vitest on packages/core/src/tools/mcp-compliance-transport.test.ts to verify the fix.
